title: Use the 5c5f4aaf desk directory as the single desk index
options: (a) Keep the 5c5f4aaf directory (linked from the root notice) as the single desk index; (b) regenerate a full root index through scripts/build.py; (c) keep several indexes
recommendation: Option (a). Link it from each desk entry page and from the README. It already exists and is cross-checked.
what_would_change_the_call: If the root banner itself must list every desk, choose (b)

title: Capture the Week 11 availability report only on publication days
options: (a) Capture daily from Wednesday to kickoff; (b) capture on the publication days and retry until the Week 11 page is served; (c) do not capture; use sibling desks' week-10 data
recommendation: Option (b). Store each fetch with its timestamp and hash. Never publish a Week 11 availability value before the page serves Week 11
what_would_change_the_call: If the league publishes a dated feed, use that instead of the page

title: Use official club codes as the canonical join key
options: (a) Use the codes printed on nfl.com standings (AZ, LA); (b) keep an alias table (LAR to LA, ARI to AZ) with a test; (c) use team names only
recommendation: Option (a) with option (b) as a tested alias table. A join that drops any club must fail the build
what_would_change_the_call: If a source uses a different official code set, add it to the alias table with a source link

title: Fix or retire the decision-desk PR check before more PRs are merged
options: (a) Fix the clean-rebuild step; (b) remove the pull_request trigger from that workflow; (c) leave it failing
recommendation: Option (a) if the owner can name the drift; otherwise option (b). Do not merge PRs that depend on a failing required check
what_would_change_the_call: If the workflow is not a required check, option (c) is acceptable

title: Consolidate the nine older open PRs
options: (a) Close superseded PRs and keep one canonical NFL desk; (b) keep all desks as separate namespaces; (c) merge the most recent desk only
recommendation: Option (a) with a canonical desk chosen by the owner after reading the desk directory. Record each closed PR in COORDINATION.md
what_would_change_the_call: If the owner wants parallel comparisons, choose (b)

title: Set the price-data policy before any price or backtest page is published
options: (a) Official sources only (prices stay blank); (b) third-party archives with provenance and a source class label; (c) a licensed feed
recommendation: Decision needed from the owner. Until then, publish no price-based number as verified
what_would_change_the_call: If an official price source is confirmed, choose (a) for official and (b) for archive data, kept separate
